messages:
monitor-bot: ALERT: sudden throughput drop (~38%) in us-west-2 inference pool. p95 latency x3. Multiple worker restarts and GPU OOMs since 14:02 UTC. Affected nodes: gfn-3-12..18. sample log: 
```
[14:03:21] worker-15: GPU OOM while allocating 152MB for KV cache growth
[14:03:22] worker-15: restarting
```
ashok: on it, pulling traces from perf pipeline and nsys captures. starting a quick heap/profile dump.
maria: noticed kernel selection flipped to `attention_fused_v1` for many small-batch requests (batch_size=1-3). that kernel has higher resident mem.
kyte: KV cache eviction rate spiked at same time. `kv_cache_evictions/sec` went from ~10 -> 420. looks like churn from low-latency customers.
eva: rolling window batching reduced (window=5ms -> 1ms) after yesterday's deploy? that would increase small batches. checking deploys.
infra-bot: deploy rollback detected: commit `a7f3b2` rolled 12:34 UTC to runtime-service (batching heuristics). correlate?
ashok: grabbing a kernel selection trace:
```
request_id=rcx-99 kernel_chosen=attention_fused_v1 reason=fallback memory_est=1.6GB hw=rtx-a6000
request_id=rcx-102 kernel_chosen=fast_attn_int8_v2 reason=matched_profile memory_est=320MB
```
maria: those two lines show fallback triggered for similarly sized inputs. heuristics are misclassifying because kv cache residency isn't in the feature vector.
kyte: profiler snapshot (nsys) shows long allocation spikes just before OOM. small batches cause more frequent KV cache growth + no coalescing -> allocator fragmentation.
jun: quick check: `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used --format=csv -l 1` shows saw-tooth pattern across the node pool. memory never fully compacts between requests.
eva: suggestion: revert batching-window back to 5ms and force kernel-selection heuristic v1 (pre-deploy) as immediate mitigation. also temporarily throttle latency-sensitive tenants to avoid single-req storm.
ashok: rolling kernel-selection revert to canary now (rt-runtime nodes 12,13). will monitor OOMs and evictions.
infra-bot: canary deployed to nodes gfn-3-12, gfn-3-13 at 14:18 UTC.
kyte: results after 5 minutes: evictions/sec down to ~25, throughput trending up + p95 back toward baseline. no new OOMs on canary nodes.
maria: root cause hypothesis: new kernel-heuristic used only request input size + sequence len; missing KV cache residency and recent allocation history -> chose memory-heavy fused kernel for many small batches. allocator fragmentation amplified by frequent small allocations -> OOM and worker restarts.
jun: follow-ups: add kv_cache_residency to kernel-selection features, add lightweight allocator compaction between requests, and tune batching-window default to balance latency/cost.
eva: owner assignments: ashok -> finish rollback and validate cluster health; maria -> produce candidate kernel heuristic patch with kv metric; kyte -> add an eviction-rate alert with 5m window; jun -> investigate allocator sweep/compaction quick-fix.
ashok: current status: canary looks healthy, rolling revert to remainder of pool starting now. will update in 10m. :thumbsup:
